label: CSV to JSON array conversion
description: Convert a small CSV file with a header row into a JSON array of objects keyed by header names, saved to a new file. Some runs use numeric-field typing, a non-default delimiter, or an installed converter CLI. One run hit a row with extra cells and the converter errored, so no output was written.
type_rationale: Fully deterministic input-to-output transform. A CLI script with options for delimiter and numeric coercion, and a defined behavior for rows with extra cells, covers every session without judgment.
